deletion.title: Delete this collection?
deletion.description: "{{name}}" will be deleted. The books inside it stay in your library. This action cannot be undone.

deletion.title: Delete this tag?
deletion.description: "{{name}}" will be removed from every book it is attached to. This action cannot be undone.

ungroup-confirm.title: Ungroup this series?
ungroup-confirm.description: "{{name}}" will be ungrouped and its books shown individually. The books themselves are not deleted.

book-deletion.title_one: Are you sure you want to delete this book?
book-deletion.title_other: Are you sure you want to delete these {{count}} books?
book-deletion.description: You are about to delete <bold>"{{bookName}}"</bold> from <bold>"{{bookshelfName}}"</bold>. This action cannot be undone.
book-deletion.description-multiple: You are about to delete <bold>{{count}} books</bold> from <bold>"{{bookshelfName}}"</bold>. This action cannot be undone.

restore-last-read.title: Restore last read book on startup
restore-last-read.description: If history is disabled, this setting will be ignored.

check-update-on-startup.title: Check for updates on startup
check-update-on-startup.description: Automatically check for a new version when the application starts.

auto-scroll.title: Auto-scroll text
auto-scroll.description: Automatically scrolls long titles in the bookshelf view. Turning this off can improve performance if the bookshelf feels slow.

dir-watch.title: Watch folders and files for changes
dir-watch.warn-message: Enabling this feature may cause high system load when opening folders with a large number of files.

reading-direction.title: Default page direction
reading-direction.description: The direction pages turn in when a book is opened for the first time. Changing the direction while reading is remembered for that book only.

first-page.title: Show the initial page in single-page view

auto-open-adjacent-book.title: Auto-open adjacent book
auto-open-adjacent-book.description: Open the next/previous book when paging past the last/first page.

auto-descend-single-folder.title: Open the folder inside an archive automatically
auto-descend-single-folder.description: When an archive holds no pages of its own and contains a single folder, open that folder instead. Repeats for nested single folders.

loupe.title: Loupe
loupe.description: Settings for the magnifier tool. Toggle it using the configured key or mouse button.
loupe.toggle-key-description: The keyboard key or mouse button used to toggle the loupe.
loupe.zoom-description: The magnification level of the loupe.
loupe.radius-description: The size of the loupe in pixels.

history-feature.title: Reading history
history-feature.description: When enabled, reading history will be saved for each book you read.

preview.title: Show preview while loading
preview.description: Displays a low-resolution thumbnail until the full image is loaded.

max-image-height.title: Maximum image height (px)
max-image-height.description:
Images taller than this will be resized proportionally.
Set zero to disable resizing.

resize-method.title: Resizing method
resize-method.description: Select the algorithm used for resizing. Choose the best balance between image quality and processing speed for your needs.

pdf.title: PDF rendering height (px)
pdf.description: Height of the PDF rendering area in pixels.

preload-page-count.title: Preload page count
preload-page-count.description: The number of pages to preload in each direction (forward and backward).

page-reader-count.title: Page reader threads
page-reader-count.description:
How many threads may read pages at once. 0 lets the app choose.
A ceiling, not a demand: formats that allow only one reader, such as solid RAR, EPUB and PDF, stay at one.
Lower this for books on a network drive, where the readers compete for one link rather than for cores.

image-cache-size.title: Image cache size (MiB)
image-cache-size.description:
The maximum size of the image memory cache in MiB.
Changing this will clear the current cache.

log-level.title: Log level
log-level.description: A restart of the application is required to apply the log level settings.

experimental-features.title: Experimental features
experimental-features.description: These features are currently under development. They may be changed or removed without notice, and functionality may be unstable.

third-party-licenses.title: Third-Party Licenses
third-party-licenses.body: This application is built with open source software.
